appsScriptUrl: PASTE THE /exec URL FROM HER OWN WEB APP DEPLOYMENT HERE
_howToUse: Copy this file, do not edit it in place. Serving one agent: name the copy config.json. Serving several from one deployment: name each copy config-<agentSlug>.json and reach it at leadbook-<slug>.yourdomain or ?agent=<slug>.

_fields.agentSlug: lowercase, no spaces. Must match the filename and the subdomain
_fields.agentName: shown in the header. The Sheet's Config tab overrides this once she signs in
_fields.agentPhone: for your records. She signs in with the phone on her Config tab, not this one
_fields.appsScriptUrl: the /exec URL from her Web App deployment
_fields.countryCode: shown fixed beside every phone box, so she types 10 digits only. Defaults to +91 if omitted
_fields.defaultCityOrder: optional. Seeds the city picker on day one only; after that the filters come from her own leads. Leave empty if unsure

_notInThisFile: The access code. It lives only on her Sheet's Config tab and is issued by the server after she signs in, so it never ships to a public host.
